title: Nightscout crashes with AndroidAPS 3.0 RC3
symptom: When making a profile change through NS Client, Nightscout crashes and needs a Dyno restart. The issue occurs with AndroidAPS 3.0 RC3 and Nightscout 14.2.5, but there was no problem with version 2.8.2.1.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. MilosKozak mentions a PR with a fix but not merged, and suggests clearing treatment collection. mountrcg observes duplicated SGV entries in NS DB, but MilosKozak states duplicated values were not coming from AAPS because AAPS always fills 'isValid' field.
fix: The only solution mentioned is to clear the treatment collection in Nightscout, as stated by MilosKozak. There is also a PR (nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor#7284) with a fix but not merged yet.
evidence_quote: i§m getting this one too time to time. there is a PR with fix but is not merged yet https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/pull/7284 the only solution now is clear treatment collection
